skill.summary: Creates a developer growth report from recent Claude Code conversations.

security_audit.summary: Most shell-execution alerts are false positives caused by Markdown fences and inline code examples; no actual command execution is present in SKILL.md. The hidden-file alerts are confirmed because the skill instructs reading ~/.claude/history.jsonl, which can include user requests, project names, timestamps, and pasted content. A semantic privacy risk remains because the report can be sent to Slack with derived details from private work history.

remediation.suggestion: Request explicit consent before reading ~/.claude/history.jsonl, narrow the date range, and redact pastedContents and secrets before analysis.

remediation.issue: Slack delivery of sensitive work context
remediation.suggestion: Make Slack delivery opt-in, show a preview, require confirmation, and allow users to disable external delivery.

remediation.issue: External searches derived from private work patterns
remediation.suggestion: Remove project names, repository names, customer data, and secrets from learning-resource search queries.

content.user_title: Analyze Developer Growth From Claude Code History
content.value_statement: Developers often need clear feedback on recurring patterns, skill gaps, and learning priorities. This skill turns recent Claude Code history into a structured growth report with resources and optional Slack delivery.
actual_capabilities: Reads local Claude Code history from the recent 24 to 48 hours.
Identifies projects, technologies, problem types, challenges, and approach patterns.
Prioritizes 3 to 5 evidence-based improvement areas with recommendations.
Produces a structured developer growth report with strengths and action items.
Searches HackerNews through Rube MCP for learning resources.
Sends formatted report sections to Slack direct messages through Rube MCP.
limitations: Requires access to ~/.claude/history.jsonl and enough recent chat data.
May expose sensitive work context if Slack or external search is enabled.
Resource quality depends on HackerNews search results and available Rube MCP tools.
Does not inspect repositories unless chat history includes relevant details.

use_cases.title: Review a focused work session
use_cases.description: Summarize recent Claude Code work and identify practical next steps for skill development.

use_cases.title: Prepare coaching topics
use_cases.description: Find recurring challenges and convert them into specific mentoring discussion points.

use_cases.title: Spot team training needs
use_cases.description: Use repeated themes from developer reports to plan learning sessions and documentation updates.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Growth Summary
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a short review of recent work.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze my recent Claude Code chats and summarize my main strengths, challenges, and growth areas.

prompt_templates.title: Prioritized Improvement Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a focused plan from recent chat history.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my last 48 hours of Claude Code chats. Prioritize three improvement areas and explain the evidence for each one.

prompt_templates.title: Learning Resource Report
prompt_templates.scenario: Pair development feedback with external reading.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a developer growth report with action items and HackerNews resources for the technologies in my recent chats.

prompt_templates.title: Weekly Coaching Report
prompt_templates.scenario: Generate a more detailed report for ongoing growth tracking.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze my recent Claude Code history for recurring architecture decisions, debugging patterns, and security habits. Prepare a weekly report and Slack DM draft.

output_examples.input: Analyze my developer growth from my recent chats.
output_examples.output: A report with recent work summary, prioritized improvement areas, observed strengths, action items, and learning resources.

output_examples.input: Review my work from today and suggest areas for improvement.
output_examples.output: A concise review of projects, technologies, repeated challenges, likely skill gaps, and next steps for focused practice.

output_examples.input: Send my weekly growth report to Slack after you prepare it.
output_examples.output: A Slack-ready report split into summary, improvement areas, strengths, action items, and curated learning links.

best_practices: Review the report before sharing it outside your workspace.
Redact secrets, customer names, and proprietary code before enabling Slack delivery.
Run analysis on a consistent weekly cadence for clearer trends.
anti_patterns: Do not send reports to Slack before reviewing sensitive details.
Do not treat inferred skill gaps as performance evaluation evidence.
Do not use broad date ranges that include unrelated private conversations.

faq.question: Does this skill need my Claude Code history file?
faq.answer: Yes. It is designed to read ~/.claude/history.jsonl for recent Claude Code conversations.

faq.question: Will it search the web?
faq.answer: It uses Rube MCP to search HackerNews for articles related to identified improvement areas.

faq.question: Can it send the report to Slack?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow can send formatted report sections to the user's Slack direct messages.

faq.question: Is it safe for private code?
faq.answer: Use caution. The history file can include pasted code, project names, and sensitive implementation details.

faq.question: Can Codex use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code support, but the workflow assumes Claude Code history data.

faq.question: Does it modify my repositories?
faq.answer: No. It reads chat history and prepares reports; it does not edit repository files.
